decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's newly announced coolant system offering, so the investment and public commitment favour persisting through a short first year.
The centrifuge completes the coolant cleaning portfolio the firm has publicly committed to, and any weak early results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complement that supports system sales, so dropping them would undercut the announced coolant line.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard part of a chip-handling range, and the firm has visibly committed to that range.
The magnetic belt conveyor fills a specific niche within the publicly launched conveyor family, so management would justify keeping it while sales build.
The hinged belt conveyor is the workhorse of chip conveyor lines and central to the announced direction, making a drop after one year very unlikely.
